batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c S Rana b YS Chahal

batting.name: CJ Anderson
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b MA Starc

batting.name: V Kohli

balls.text: yorker, angling in, hits him on the toe, concedes a leg-bye
yorker, dug out to point, they jog through for one. Chahal misses with an attempt at a direct-hit
fuller, quicker, wants the leg-bye to point, but there is no run here. Malinga has given up, and this time Yuvraj doesn't miss
short of a length, outside off, he looks to run this down to third man, and is beaten
full, crunched away to long-off for one. It is wide of long-off, but with AB you can't chance the second
Ojha drops this towards point, wants a single, Malinga has given up, but Yuvraj's throw misses
full, on the pads, the leg-bye means Ojha keeps strike

Aaron telegraphs the slower ball with a change of action. Harbhajan slogs across the line of this offcutter, and has his leg stump pegged back. The speed gun still says 142ks. Like I believe ya, speed gun
Harbhajan backs away to try to open the off-side field, gets a thick edge over extra cover for two
on a length, pushed to cover to bring Bhajan back to strike
another two-handed forehand from Harbhajan. Gets a single to long-on
bangs the first ball in short, Harbhajan forehands it over mid-off for four. Not clean connection, but the man is up in the circle
on a length, outside off, Malinga again ends up swinging inside the line
outswinger, outside off, Malinga swings inside the line
full, on off, driven to long-off for one
bouncer, Harbhajan ducks under it again
and another hole-out. This is too easy for RCB. Quicksand for Mumbai. Nothing behind this shot. Caught at long-on
short ball, gets stuck in the surface, Zaheer has to wait for it to arrive, and can't place it anywhere
bouncer from round the stumps, Harbhajan ducks it. An excellent over from Starc
Starc gets the edge on the hat-trick ball, but it doesn't carry to Parthiv Patel
Starc is on a hat-trick. Too much pressure put on Anderson by the top order. Anderson gets a touch too under a length ball, lofts this towards long-off where Kohli takes it overhead

another catch for AB. What ground speed to make it look easy. This is a slower-ball length ball hit wide of long-off, but AB makes so much ground he doesn't even have to dive. A scratchy innings from Rayudu
on a length, angling in, mis-hit wide of long-on, where Rana does well again to save two runs
Anderson slogs at a length ball, gets an inside edge for one
nearly bowled him. Another wrong'un, Anderson gets a bottom edge on the slog sweep, but it misses the stumps. Chahal ends his four overs without conceding a boundary
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, the mis-hit doesn't carry to long-on
only wrong'uns he is bowling, punched to long-off for one
another wrong'un, a touch too short, punched away between two men deep on the off side
wrong'un again, a touch too short, but can't beat cover
short of a length, pulled to deep midwicket for one
slower ball, nearly a return catch for Dinda, as this mis-hit goes past his right hand as dives against the momentum of his follow-through
drilled to long-off for one

down the wicket, almost yorks himself up, but Kohli is sensational at cover. Charges to his right, swoops, collects it one-handed, is off balance, and still releases it fast and accurately. Nearly the run-out
short of a length, on off, looks to cut, but can't beat point
full outside off, driven to long-off for one
low full toss just outside off, dug out to cover for one
slower ball, on a length, on off, beats his attempt to drive
another short ball, 142ks again, Anderson is late into the pull again, and this time the top edge evades fine leg. Story of Mumbai's innings
another short ball, 142ks, quite aggressive, Anderson has to sway out of this
mis-hit falls safe. Another good bouncer from Aaron, Anderson looks to pull, ends up to-ending it, and the edge lands smack in between long-on and long-off
short of a length, wide, crunched away, but can't beat backward point

Rayudu gives him the charge, the ball is shorter than ideal for such a shot, and he pushes it towards point for one. Kohli swoops in, underarms this towards the stumps, and he would have had Anderson had he hit. Good effort, though
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for the sixth run of the over
short of a length, on the pads, gets a single to long-on
slows this one down, but bowls it outside leg, and is wided
pushes one through, at 99ks, across Anderson, beats his edge on the cut
stays slow, on a length, outside off, pushed to long-off for one
long hop, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, slow, pushed to long-off
and there is the wrong'un, Anderson hasn't read it, but he has played it with soft hands so the edge doesn't carry to slip
flighted on off, pushed to short straight cover
flighted outside off, pushed to long-off
full and straight, pushes this low full toss to long-on

Chahal is on a roll. This is an all-Haryana wicket. Chahal, a former Mumbai Indians legspinner who never got any chances with them, is running through them here. He continues to give the ball air, pitches this up on middle and leg, drilled to long-on where Sachin Rana times his leap to perfection to take this overhead
short of a length, outside off, cut away for one
drilled to long-on as he pitches this up
short of a length, outside off, punched away in front of deep cover. Starc dives to keep it to two
full, outside off, slight shape away, beats the drive. Proper outswinger
short of a length, wide, cut away in front of third man for two
short again, into the ribs, tucked away for one
short of a length, gets this to rise towards the chest, fended to cover
slow through the air again, clipped away for a single to leg
nice flight on this one, but not turn from middle and leg. Hits the inside edge
short of a length, middle and leg, worked into the leg side for another single
another flighted delivery, pushed into the leg side for one
flighted on off, defended back to him

Chahl's day has turned. it began with a dolly dropped, but he has come back with a catch, a near run-out and now the big wicket. Wrong'un from Chahl, on a length, just outside off, Sharma lazily drives into it. Makes no attempt to keep it down, nor is he trying to hit it out of the ground. Provides long-off a sitter. And AB won't be dropping any
slower ball, Rayudu is beaten as he gives charge and swings wildly
short of a length, outside off, pushed towards point where an alert Kohli denies them a run
short of a length, pretty straight, bunted to leg for one. Dinda barges into Rayudu as he dashes across to field. No unpleasantness between the two. They are both doing their job
fuller, outside off, move away. Left alone
Dinda stays short and wide, the batsman's feet stay stuck, and and the edge is beaten
short, wide, Rayudu goes after it without feet, and edges it over point for one
down the wicket to drive this to long-on for one
pushed wide of long-on this time, and the come back for the second
appeal for lbw as he looks to work this to leg. This wrong'un has turned too far, though
short of a length, on the pads, worked to leg for one
down the wicket to drill this down straight of long-off, and the flying AB saves three runs there with the dive and a quick throw
straight length ball, defended
down the wicket, more in hope than conviction, gets a thick outside edge for one

Tare's torture ends. This has been a painful innings from Tare. And he has looked completely at sea against the short ball. Aaraon gives him another bouncer, and he top-edges it to Maddinson in the deep on the leg side. Like Chahal, Maddinson also gets the man he reprieved
third mistake from Parthiv behind the stumps. Fumbles a take on the bouncer. What should have been a dot is a bye
on a length, outside off, driven to deep cover
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man for one
on a length, outside off, good bounce for Aaron. Beats the edge
on a length, just outside off, another wild attempt at a drive. Beaten. An error-filled - from both sides - and ordinary Powerplay comes to an end
this is a better short ball. Just outside off, nips in a little, beats Tare's attempt at the ramp
The Morkel Meltdown. Wild wide slower one. Parthiv Patel is a short man. Can't reach this down the leg side
one over too many for Morkel? No energy behind this bowling. Gentle, on a length, wide, and Tare crashes it over cover for four
gentle bouncer, no sting behind it, and he has been dismissed through midwicket region. This is a slower bouncer. Tare has been struggling with bouncers bowled at conventional pace
short of a length, angling in, worked to leg for one
down the wicket, takes a length ball, swipes it through midwicket for four

Chahal might have got a run out here. Tare continues to be edge, jumps out of the crease, gets a thick edge. it flies over cover, Chahal chases it down well, keeps it in, relays it to a fielder, who slips and relays it to another, who spears the throw in, and Parthiv Patel messes the run-out up by flicking the bails without collecting the ball
this bouncer has got big on him, Tare looks to drag it from outside off, and gets a top edge that clears mid-on
short of a length, holds its line in front of middle and leg, bunted to leg for one
short of a length, outside off, punched away, Chahal makes a diving save at cover-point to save three runs
short of a length, wide, moves further away. Called a wide
short of a length, just outside off, dropped towards cover for one
short of a length, angling in, gets an inside edge onto the pad for a single

Chahal makes up for the earlier drop. And RCB haven't paid much for it. Hussey has only wasted deliveries. He is hurried into this shovel-pull. Mostly because the ball is not short enough, and he ends up slicing it to square leg
jumps out of the crease, gives this a wild heave, and is beaten by the slower one
Tare is beaten on the pull by the slower Morkel too. Gets a leg-bye too
short, wide, no-ball too, and Tare fails to put this away, finding the cover-point. This is no-ball because Morkel has knocked the bail off while bowling
short of a length, jags back in from just outside off, and cuts him into two. Tare looking out of depth
on a length, outside off, Hussey goes back to steer this to third man
sharp bouncer through Tare even before he can come around to pull. And it is followed by a mouthful from the bowler
full, outside off, doesn't swing back, beats Tare's extravagant drive on the outside edge
too full, too straight, clipped away for a single
too straight this time, clipped away past square leg for two
lovely square push drive. Full outside off, Hussey presses forward, covers the swing, and meets it with an open face. Bisects square cover and cover
Hussey gives Starc the charge, and is beaten by the swing from just outside off
full, outside off, driven wide of mid-off for one
length ball, on the pads, pushed to leg but not far enough to get a single
short of a length, on off, seams away, beats the bat as he pushes at it
pushed wide of mid-off for one
another drop. IPL living up to its abysmal fielding standards. Tare plays a loose push at a wide length ball. Gets the edge. Maddinson at first slip drops a knee-height dolly
short, wide, no feet from Tare. Beaten on the cut as the ball shapes away a touch
swinging, on off, really full, dug out
short and wide, outside off, Hussey must think it is his birthday. Two gifts in an over. Cut away for four
left alone outside off

Hussey keeps getting lives. Last year he was dropped three times by Pollard last year. This time he drives straight to Chahal at point. This is an action replay of those drops. A sitter really. No wonder Hussey loves IPL
short of a length, tucked away off the hip
short of a length, angling in, Hussey gets off the strike with a bunted single to leg
and RCB are there. PP opens the face on this slower ball, and runs away for a single, and pumps the air even before reaching the non-striker's end
PP gets a length ball from Malinga with mid-off up, and he sends it over the fielder's head. Scores are level now
full from round the stumps, steered away for a couple
beautiful shot. Tossed up outside off, and he goes inside-out, chips it over extra cover
fired in shortish, punched to cover
there is the fifty for PP. Fighting knock but just what RCB needed. Opens the face, takes the single
PP is finishing this off in a hurry. Makes room again, takes this on the half-volley, and lobs this over mid-off again
lovely shot. PP makes room, takes this on the half-volley, and drives it over mid-off for a smooth four
on a length, middle and leg, goes off the inside edge for one
reverse-swept again, can't beat short third again. Takes the single. Tight spell from Harbhajan - 4-0-14-0
short of a length, punched away in the air, Rohit Sharma dives at extra cover, but can't quite hold on to it
down the wicket, not quite to the pitch of the ball, but gets a single to long-on
looks to reverse, Harbhajan fires this one in, AB misses, but he has got just outside the line
accurate and flighted again, defended back to him
tossed up, turning into the pads, pushed to midwicket
short again, punched to deep cover for one
mis-hits a pull this time, but this doesn't carry to long-on
short and wide, cut away towards deep cover, comes back for the second despite his short steps
short of a length, on middle and leg, punched to deep cover for one
another long hop, pulled to deep square this time for one
long hop outside leg with fine leg up. That's how you finish a match early. PP helps it along
walks down again, takes this one the full, clips this to deep square for another single
wide down the leg side
down the wicket, drills this straight to mid-off, but he is so quick he has strolled through for one
short of a length, middle and leg, hit straight to midwicket
walks down the wicket to drive this to deep midwicket for one
short of a length, driven powerfully to deep cover for one
short of a length, shuffles across to place this into the leg side and scampers back for twp
tries another ramp, but this ball is neither as high as the previous nor as wide. Beaten. Actually this is not beaten. He has edged it, but they don't even appeal
bouncer, just outside off, 135ks, and PP rises with it, and ramps it over the keeper's head. Smart batting
one slower ball too many. Misses the yorker too. Turns out to be a half-volley on off, which PP scoops over cover for four
yorker, the slower one, 129ks, dug out by PP, but can't get a single
short of a length, into the ribs, tucked away for a single that brings up fifty for the stand and brings the target under 50
slower ball, on a length, middle and leg, Parthiv bunts him for one. AB runs with his helmet in his hand
full toss, lucky that AB has hit it straight to mid-off
driven on the up, driven hard, but can't beat extra cover
short of a length, steered away from just outside off for one
short of a length, angling in, pushed wide of point for one
on a length, angling in towards off, defended with an open face
unorthodox but predictable Burmah. Short, angling in, AB lines him up, covers the stumps, and goes boom. The first six of the match. Would you believe it?
looks to work this to leg from just outside off, gets a single off the leading edge
looks for the extra-cover drive, the ball holds up a little, hits the inside edge
short, on off, slapped to long-off for one
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, but takes a single off the inside edge
not too short, but short enough for AB to rock back and pull this wide of deep midwicket for four. He punishes the slightest of errors
nearly taken. AB goes hard at the drive, fails to keep it down, but this falls just short of the diving extra cover
another reverse-sweep, makes a sweet connection this time, but can't beat Zaheer at short third man
pushed through, pulled to long-on for one
tries the reverse sweep against the turn. His body has got outside its line as the ball turns in appreciably. Still manages a single to short third
tries the rare low-percentage shot, looks to heave this over leg, gets an inside edge to short fine leg
slower through the air, no turn, not a half-volley, AB defends
toppie, AB is beaten in the flight as he charges down. Hit on the pad, but outside the line
full, on off, driven to deep cover for one
slower, just short of a length, pushed to point
too short, pulled away to deep square leg for one
short of a length, pretty straight, defended to leg
tossed up, on off, pushed wide of cover for one
first ball is short and pushed through, Parthiv opens the face late, guides it past short third, and AB charges back for the third
plays the reverse-paddle this time, beats the keeper, gets two
dances down the track, right to the pitch of the ball, and drills this back at Harbhajan
this one stays low. Just short of a length, outside off, stays low, squeezes under the toe of the bat. Misses the stump
gets outside the line even as he is beaten on the sweep. Takes the leg-bye
short of a length, offbreak, punched to wide long-on for one
short of a length, middle and off, punched to long-on for one
slower ball, on off, pushed wide of cover for one
short of a length, on the pads, defended back to him
slower ball, wide outside off, driven to deep cover
short, angling away, gets a thick edge on the cut, takes the single to third man
short of a length, angling in, pushed to mid-on for one
short, wide, cut away in front of third man for two
on a length, just outside off, nicely pushed to mid-off
short of a length, well down leg, with fine leg up, clipped away for four
short and wide, cut away in front of square, Rohit Sharma's dive from cover saves three runs
short of a length, outside off, punched to cover
slower ball, on a length, outside off, he leaves it be
on a length, seams in, takes the inside edge, AB takes the single. Seems like PP is batting on a different strip to what has been rolled out for AB
AB is too good. Slower ball, too full but not full enough to be a yorker, and AB meets it with a full face to drive it to the left of mid-on for four
AB stays deep in the crease to convert this yorker into a full ball, and drives this back at Malinga who sticks his foot out to prevent any runs
slower length ball, 133ks, AB manages to clear point with this push gone wrong
bowls short. AB rises with the bounce, fends with soft hands. He is definitely surprised that this is not a yorker
this yorker has gone slightly wrong. The low full toss is steered to third man for one
lovely yorker, on the crease, on off, takes the bottom inner half of the bat
squares AB up as this shortish delivery jags away a touch. AB' soft hands mean the edge doesn't carry to second slip

Tare won't pay for that slip. The wilyold Zaheer has produced a beauty. The last delivery shaped away from Yuvraj, but this time he slips in a quick delivery - at 139ks, the fastest you are likely to see Zaheer bowl - that skids through after pitching short of a length outside off. The beauty is that it seams back in, and catches the cement-footed Yuvraj plumb

poor cricket all around. Yuvraj tries the same steer as Kohli, knowing well that there is a slip in place. Gets a faint edge to the keeper but Tare drops a sitter. He batted poorly, and is not proving to be great guns with the bigger gloves

Oh Kohli. What an un-Kohli-like dismissal. This is as soft as Kohli will ever get. Steers a short-of-a-length delivery straight to slip. Had he responded to PP's call last ball, Kohli wouldn't even have been on strike to do this
short of a length, Kohli moves across to work this to square leg. PP wants one, but Kohli doesn't. PP has to dive back in
short of a length, wide, slashed away to third man for one
the quicker yorker this time. Squeezes under Maddinson's bat. Vintage Malinga. His 50th bowled victim in the IPL. Too good from Malinga
slower yorker, this time Maddinson sees it, opens the face on it, gets a thick edge fine of third man for four
full, on off, driven with an open face, can't beat cover
slower yorker, right on the crease, dug out by Maddinson
low full toss this time, pushed to mid-off to get off the strike
full, nearly a yorker, thuds low into the pad. Missing leg, though
short again, slapped away, between cover-point and extra cover for one
short, PP goes back and cuts, but can't beat point
moves across to try to sweep this, is beaten, but has got outside the line to rule out the lbw
full, on the pads, defended to leg
short of a length, looks to pull, mis-hits it to mid-on
starts with the doosra from round the wicket, but Maddinson recovers well, and opens the face past slip for three. Zaheer has to trundle all the way from short third
full, on off, driven to mid-off
nice movement away from the left-hand batsman, beats Parthiv as he pushes at it without conviction
overpitched, angling in, clipped away past midwicket
slight swing back in, beats the inside edge, concedes a leg-bye
short of a length, wide, he throws his bat it, gets a thick edge over point for four
short of a length, outside off, stays low, beats the punch
